name: Ouroboros
description: 【效率扩展】 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的专业能力扩展插件，提供深度集成、免配置一键安装与高效自动化辅助支持。
descriptionEn: Agent OS: the agent gets smarter on its own. We just hold the line: the grading command and expected result never make it into the success contract we hand it. Interview-gated, staged evaluation, budgeted evolution loop. MCP server, 13 runtimes: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro and more.
author: MingLin
